channel: Claude Code chat, AskUserQuestion answers after the catalogue tail receipt (docs/readiness/2026-10-24/catalogue_tail_receipt.md)

decisions.question: E1
decisions.asked: FGDC-2817 (urea in the Bering Sea, Okeanologiya 1993) is the last of the 37 records you cleared. It has a second hold that was not on the evidence sheet: access text "Check with Contributor" and use text "Refer to webstite URL: http://www.csa.com/" (CSA = Cambridge Scientific Abstracts). 15 sources carry this exact pair and 13 are already published. Do these texts restrict only the article/data, not the catalogue record?
decisions.effect: access hold cleared; publish with the B2 creators Kavakina, S.V.; Sapozhnikov, V.V. after independent review

decisions.question: E2
decisions.asked: 4 published records show a map point in the wrong hemisphere. Fix them by an in-place update with no map and the box as text?
decisions.effect: no map change; recorded as a known source error

decisions.question: E3
decisions.asked: The 7 creators64 holds have compound, venue or unnamed credits. What do you want for them?
decisions.answer: determine creators yourself, without my review and publish
decisions.effect: the agent determines each creator from the record's own evidence; an independent AI accuracy review replaces Brett's review; publish the approved ones

decisions.question: E4
decisions.asked: v2 maps only the first <stdorder> (ordering) block. 35 DFO Ocean Science and Productivity records have a second block (digital format, size, media, fees, data locations) that is only in the attached public XML. Map it too?
decisions.effect: change the v2 mapping to carry every ordering block, re-review, and update the published records in place (same DOI, new revision)
